question: Select the** correctly spelt **word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Schemes"** refers to plans or arrangements for attaining a particular objective. (योजनाएँ)
 
 
• **Example:** The government introduced several new schemes to support small businesses.
 
 

 
• The word **"Malnourished"** means suffering from malnutrition, which is the lack of proper nutrition. (कुपोषित)
 
 
• **Example:** The charity organization is working to provide food to malnourished children in the region.
 
 
 
 
• The word **"Recognizable"** means easily identified or acknowledged. (पहचाने जाने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The actor's face is recognizable even in a crowd.
 
 

 
• The word **"Integrated"** means combined or brought together to form a whole. (एकीकृत)
 
 
• **Example:** The new software is fully integrated with the existing system.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the correctly spelt word is **"Schemes"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Malnourised** (कुपोषित): Incorrect spelling of "Malnourished".
 
 
• **Example:** The children in the remote village are malnourished due to lack of access to nutritious food.
 
 

 
• **Recognisabel** (पहचाने जाने योग्य): Incorrect spelling of "Recognizable".
 
 
• **Example:** Her voice is easily recognizable on the phone.
 
 

 
• **Intigrated** (एकीकृत): Incorrect spelling of "Integrated".
 
 
• **Example:** The various departments have been integrated to improve efficiency.
